title: Signed amounts
prompt: The balance report adds amounts up, so money leaving an account must be negative. Write `solve(transactions)` so it returns `transaction_id`, `direction`, `amount` and a new `signed_amount`.
rules: Any other direction, or a missing one, gives a missing `signed_amount`. Directions are matched exactly: `DEBIT` isn't `debit`.
`signed_amount` keeps the type of `amount`, `decimal(12,2)`. Return the four columns, in that order, for every transaction.
hints: Without `otherwise`, rows that match neither get `NULL`.
`-F.col("amount")` flips the sign and keeps the type; multiplying by `-1` widens it.
starter:
